name: @taprootcms/studio-app
description: The Taproot CMS deployment: admin panel, REST API, delivery API, and the scheduler

scripts.//dev: The port is pinned, as it already is for apps/web and apps/docs, because 4321 is not merely a default here — it is written into .env.example's TAPROOT_ORIGIN, apps/web/.env's TAPROOT_API_URL, scripts/a11y-audit.mjs's default base, and the URL seed.ts prints at the end. Left as Astro's bare default, a busy 4321 moves the studio to the next free port and every one of those quietly addresses a server that is no longer there: the consumer stops resolving content and the audit runs against whatever else answered. `strictPort` then makes that collision a startup error instead of a drift, which is the only version of it anybody notices.
